look_here_first: Look for BROAD, FLAT spoon/obovate fleshy leaves with round or slightly notched tips and inconspicuous hairs at successive axils. Mature fruits open with a HORIZONTAL detachable lid but have NO expanded encircling wing like P. umbraticola. P. pilosa has narrow, near-cylindrical leaves and conspicuous long white axillary hair tufts. Yellow flower color is secondary.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Prostrate/spreading often reddish succulent annual, low mat-forming stems, short taproot.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Flattened obovate or spatulate leaves generally 4–28 × 2–13 mm, apex round to shallowly notched; alternate to subopposite at nodes.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Small flowers typically 3–10 mm diam with short yellow petals; ephemeral, often sunshine opening; don't ID by flower color.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: Ovoid unwinged circumscissile capsule usually 4–9 mm diam, 'hat/lid' detaches transversely to release many black/brown flattened seeds.

key_traits.label: Seeds
key_traits.text: Dark seeds around 0.6–1.1 mm with granular or rounded-tuberculate cells; macro needed for fine seed-coat differentiation.

key_traits.label: Axils
key_traits.text: Glabrous or only short inconspicuous trichomes around inflorescence/nodes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Broad, flattened spoon-like succulent leaves (not narrow terete).

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Unwinged mature capsule with transverse cap-like lid; photograph opened and unopened fruit.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Short or absent axillary hairs at multiple fresh stem nodes.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Distinguish overlapping flat-leaved P. umbraticola using actual mature capsule wing.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Do not use reddish stem, prostrate growth or yellow flowers alone.
